semantic_review: All five Rogers categories discussed with a named social system and no automatic percentage threshold
General technology findings materially stable across cases; availability distinguished from population adoption
Software-company versus startup preserves the coding application but changes peer context and conditional timing for explicit reasons
Hospital changes application and consequence/peer context without changing general technology evidence
All five characteristics assessed with observed-versus-inferred status, direction, condition and confidence
Accelerators and inhibitors, opinion-leader/change-agent roles, channels, ecosystem/standards and complementary assets are bounded by evidence
Fast Follower/AI-native/Conservative labels do not predetermine a population stage or local peer rank
Weak hospital penetration claim explicitly qualified/abstained; missing survey attributes requested
Source IDs, dates, URLs, denominators and recency limitations traceable; blocked leads not treated as verified
Timing response has immediate action, later evidence gate and delay/reversal condition without full adoption authorization
One stable and one changed cross-case conclusion identified after real runs
At least one actual output weakness preserved, diagnosed and controlled/retested; do not invent a failure if none identified
Distinguish awareness, trial, individual current and recurrent use, sustained organizational deployment and industry penetration
Do not call E2 a new 2025 survey or treat E2/E4 as independent replication
Preserve E1 60% AI-user denominator and E4 74.9% coding-responsibility denominator; do not call them firm/hospital deployment or daily telemetry
Acknowledge empirical adoption evidence exists while preserving broad-AI scope, non-longitudinal nature and incomplete 2025 sampling methods
No 2024/2025 percentage subtraction is represented as longitudinal growth; 2026 qualitative publication does not refresh old rates
revision_rule: Preserve original raw responses and packet bytes; increment version and use new unused filenames for revisions. Do not change cases to hide failure. Regenerate all packets when shared evidence changes.
